title: dsh-theme.json
description: Portable Theme Studio theme file, format v1. One file carries one theme: a 13-field color palette per official scheme plus optional sparse token overrides. The plugin's TypeScript parser (src/client/theme-file.ts) is the authoritative validator; this schema additionally covers the structural and identifier rules so editors can lint theme files. Color syntax beyond the listed prefixes, the light/dark override key symmetry, and duplicate-id policy are enforced by the parser.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema; ignored by the plugin.

version.description: File format version. Omitted means 1; any other value is rejected.

id.description: Stable theme identifier. Lowercase letters, digits, dots and dashes; 1-64 chars. Must not use the builtin 'dsh-theme-studio.' namespace or the reserved words default/light/dark/system.

name.description: Display name shown in the theme menu. A plain string; no localization object.

description.description: Optional longer description shown in dialogs and management.

palette.description: The 13 chrome colors per official color scheme. deriveChrome() expands them into the full token surface.

overrides.description: Optional sparse token overrides applied after deriveChrome(). Both schemes must list the same token names.

color.description: CSS color in the plugin's resolver subset: #hex 3/4/6/8, rgb()/rgba(), var(--token[, fallback]), color-mix(in srgb, ...), or the keywords transparent/black/white.

tokenOverrides.description: Token names restricted to --dsw-*, --shiki-* and --dsh-* prefixes; variables owned by official font settings are rejected.
